person.name: Suryansh Sharma
person.bio: I'm a pre-final-year B.Tech student in Computer Science and Engineering at COER University (2024–2028), focused on backend engineering with Node.js and Express.js. I build REST APIs, payment workflows, and full-stack applications, and I enjoy working across databases, cloud deployment, containerized infrastructure, and AI-powered developer tools. My goal is to build dependable software that solves practical problems and is designed with security, maintainability, and scale in mind.

Build reliable services with clear boundaries, secure integrations, observability, and thoughtful error handling.

Keep learning through building, debugging, documenting, and iterating.
